data.description: As a standard action, a clockwork golem can fold into a whirling wall of grinding gears measuring 10 feet by 10 feet or 5 feet by 20 feet.  Anyone passing through the wall takes 15d6 points of slashing damage.  If the wall appears in a creature's space, that creature can attempt a DC %1 Reflex save to leap to one side and avoid the damage entirely.  The clockwork golem can take no actions while in this form except to resume its normal form as a move action.  A clockwork golem's AC and immunities remain the same while it is in this form.
data.name: Wall of Gears
